section.content: 传统的半导体集成电路器件中，用于防止回流电流的装置具有高导通状态电阻，这使得在正常操作中不可能减少电压损失。本发明半导体集成电路器件具有第一MOS晶体管、设置于第一MOS晶体管与电源端子之间的第二MOS晶体管，以及在正常操作中将第二MOS晶体管的栅极保持在预定电位(最好是地电位)以及当很可能出现回流电流时使第二MOS晶体管截止的装置。在正常操作中，这有助于防止回流电流，同时减少电压损失。

In a conventional semiconductor integrated circuit device, a means for preventing a backflow current has a high on-state resistance, which makes it impossible to reduce the voltage loss in normal operation. A semiconductor integrated circuit device of the invention has a first MOS transistor, a second MOS transistor provided between the first MOS transistor and a power supply terminal, and a means that, in normal operation, keeps the gate of the second MOS transistor at a predetermined potential (preferably the ground potential) and that, when a backflow current is likely, turns the second MOS transistor off. This helps prevent a backflow current while reducing the voltage loss in normal operation.

Semiconductor deviceThe Japanese patent application No.2003-101366 that the application submitted to based on April 4th, 2003, this paper merges reference with its content.

Technical field

The present invention relates to a kind of semiconductor device with MOS transistor.More specifically, the present invention relates to a kind of semiconductor device that is used for stoping MOS transistor current reflux device that is equipped with.

Background technology

As shown in Figure 4, some semiconductor devices comprise P channel MOS transistor Q5, and this transistor has the supply voltage V that is added on its source electrode and back of the body grid (backgate) DDIn this MOS transistor Q5, carry on the back grid from draining to and formed parasitic diode D5.

As a result, when reverse bias MOS transistor Q5 and the voltage that will be higher than the parasitic diode forward voltage add when being given between source electrode and the drain electrode, this parasitic diode D5 conducting, and the back flow current parasitic diode D5 that flows through.

The multiple semiconductor device of Ti Chuing all is equipped with the device that is used to prevent this back flow current traditionally.For example, in adjuster shown in Figure 5, conductive terminal t1 and as an end of the back of the body grid of the P channel MOS transistor Q1 of output transistor be added with supply voltage V DDThe other end of power supply terminal 1 between, the P channel MOS transistor Q2 as the power cut-out switch function is set.The conductive terminal t4 of MOS transistor Q2 links to each other with power supply terminal 1, and the back of the body grid of conductive terminal t3 and MOS transistor Q2 are linked to each other with the back of the body grid of grid with conductive terminal t1 and MOS transistor Q1.The conductive terminal t2 of MOS transistor Q1 is linked to each other with lead-out terminal 2.In adjuster shown in Figure 5, be higher than supply voltage V when adding to lead-out terminal 2 from the outside DDVoltage the time, MOS transistor Q2 ends, this has just prevented back flow current.

On the other hand, in the flat 10-341141 of Japanese patent application pending trial Publication Laid-Open, at back of the body grid one end of conductive terminal and P channel MOS output transistor and add between the other end of power supply terminal of outer power voltage, power cut-out switch is set, thereby when the supply voltage of monitoring circuit recognizes that this supply voltage descends, deenergization cuts off switch, and this has just prevented back flow current.

But, in adjuster shown in Figure 5 because the grid of MOS transistor Q2 links to each other with conductive terminal t3, in normal running (as supply voltage V DDThe voltage V that is higher than lead-out terminal 2 OUTThe operation of Shi Zhihang) in, can not make the grid of MOS transistor Q2 and the voltage between the conductive terminal t4 sufficiently high, therefore in normal running, conductive terminal t3 and the voltage between the t4 of MOS transistor Q2 are very high.The on-state resistance that this means MOS transistor Q2 in normal running is very high.This makes it can not reduce the loss of voltage in normal running.

On the other hand, in the output-stage circuit that the flat 10-341141 of Japanese patent application pending trial Publication Laid-Open proposes, do not provide consideration to the on-state resistance of power cut-out switch at all.This makes under the very high situation of the connected state resistance of power cut-out switch, can not reduce the loss of voltage in normal running (operation of carrying out when outer power voltage is higher than predetermined level).

Summary of the invention

The objective of the invention is to, a kind of semiconductor device is provided, can prevent back flow current, and in normal running, operate with the low-voltage loss.

To achieve these goals, according to the present invention, a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit is equipped with: first MOS transistor has first grid, first back of the body grid, first conducting region and second conducting region, and its first back of the body grid and first conducting region is electrically connected; Second MOS transistor has second grid, second back of the body grid, the 3rd conducting region and the 4th conducting region, and makes its second back of the body grid and the 3rd conducting region carry on the back grid with described first and first conducting region is electrically connected, and receives first direct voltage at its 4th conducting region; Comparator compares described first direct voltage and second direct voltage of exporting from described second conducting region; And switch, be used for operating according to the output of comparator, when being higher than described second direct voltage with described first direct voltage of box lunch, second grid is linked to each other with predetermined potential, and when described first direct voltage is lower than described second direct voltage, second grid is linked to each other with described the 3rd conducting region or second conducting region.

In this structure, at reverse-bias state, promptly when first direct voltage was lower than second direct voltage, second MOS transistor was ended, and this has prevented the back flow current in first MOS transistor.On the other hand, in normal running, promptly when first direct voltage is higher than second direct voltage, the grid of second MOS transistor is linked to each other with predetermined potential, this makes the resistance that can reduce by the second MOS transistor conducting state.Therefore, can in normal running, reduce the loss of voltage.Here, when its grid linked to each other with ground, the on-state resistance of second MOS transistor was in its maximum, and therefore, in normal running, promptly when first direct voltage was higher than second direct voltage, preferably the grid with second MOS transistor linked to each other with ground.

By using the MOS transistor identical with the conductance of first and second MOS transistor, utilize the parasitic diode that in second MOS transistor, forms, can prevent the back flow current that causes by the parasitic diode that in first MOS transistor, forms.Owing to can form P channel MOS transistor, preferably use the P channel MOS transistor as whole first and second MOS transistor than N-channel MOS transistor smaller szie.

Embodiment

As the example that realizes semiconductor device of the present invention, below a kind of adjuster will be described.Fig. 1 shows the schematic diagram of realizing controller structure example of the present invention.Should be noted that in Fig. 1, utilize these circuit elements that also can in Fig. 5, find of identical reference numbers identify, and no longer repeat their detailed description.

Adjuster shown in Figure 1 is equipped with power supply terminal 1, lead-out terminal 2, reference voltage source 3, error amplifier 4, switch 5, comparator 6, P channel MOS transistor Q1 and Q2, and resistor R 1 and R2.

Between power supply terminal 1 and lead-out terminal 2, MOS transistor Q1 and Q2 series connection.Specifically, power supply terminal 1 links to each other with the conductive terminal t4 of MOS transistor Q2; The back of the body grid of MOS transistor Q2 and conductive terminal t3 link to each other with conductive terminal t1 and the back of the body grid of MOS transistor Q1, and the conductive terminal t2 of MOS transistor Q1 links to each other with lead-out terminal 2.Be noted here that in MOS transistor Q1,, promptly form parasitic diode D1 to back of the body grid from conductive terminal t2 along direction shown in the figure, and, in MOS transistor Q2,, promptly form parasitic diode D2 to back of the body grid from conductive terminal t4 along direction shown in the figure.

Resistor R 1 is connected with R2, thereby has formed output voltage detecting circuit, and an end of this circuit links to each other other end ground connection with the node that MOS transistor Q1 will link to each other with lead-out terminal 2.The node that resistor R 1 is linked to each other with R2 links to each other with the in-phase input end of error amplifier 4.Reference voltage source 3 is with reference voltage V REFOffer the reversed input terminal of error amplifier 4.The output signal of error amplifier 4 is offered the grid of MOS transistor Q1.

The node that the in-phase input terminal of comparator 6 and power supply terminal 1 are linked to each other with MOS transistor Q2 links to each other, and the node that the reversed input terminal of comparator 6 is linked to each other with lead-out terminal 2, MOS transistor Q1 and resistor R 1 is continuous.The output signal of comparator 6 is offered switch 5.

Switch 5 has contact 5a, 5b and 5c, according to the output of comparator 6, determines how these contacts 5a is switched to the connection of 5c.The contact 5a of switch 5 links to each other with the grid of MOS transistor Q2; The contact 5b ground connection of switch 5, and the contact 5c of switch 5 links to each other with the node that MOS transistor Q1 links to each other with Q2.

Now, the operation of the adjuster of structure describes to having as above.At first, will provide its normal running (as supply voltage V DDThe voltage V that is higher than lead-out terminal 2 places OUTThe operation of Shi Zhihang).Comparator 6 makes supply voltage V DDVoltage V with lead-out terminal 2 places OUTCompare, and, if supply voltage V DDThe voltage V that is higher than lead-out terminal 2 places OUT, comparator 6 control switchs 5 then are so that its contact 5a links to each other with 5b.When the contact of switch 5 5a links to each other with 5b, the grounded-grid of MOS transistor Q2, so the supply voltage V no better than of the voltage between the grid of MOS transistor Q2 and the conductive terminal t3 DDThis causes the on-state resistance of MOS transistor Q2 to reach its maximum, and therefore helps to reduce the loss of voltage.

By deduct the voltage of voltage drop between the conductive terminal t1 that equals MOS transistor Q1 and the t2 from the voltage of the conductive terminal t3 that offers MOS transistor Q2, MOS transistor Q1 has produced voltage V OUT, then with this voltage V OUTOffer lead-out terminal 2.

Cut apart voltage V by the output voltage detecting circuit that resistor R 1 and R2 form OUT, and error amplifier 4 will with dividing potential drop result and reference voltage V REFBetween the corresponding control signal of difference offer MOS transistor Q1.By this FEEDBACK CONTROL, voltage V OUTBe maintained at predetermined level.

Next, will provide working as supply voltage V DDBecome and be lower than the voltage V at lead-out terminal 2 places OUTThe time adjuster performed operation explanation, for example as supply voltage V DDDuring shorted to earth, perhaps when from the outside high voltage being added when being given on the lead-out terminal 2.6 couples of supply voltage V of comparator DDVoltage V with lead-out terminal 2 places OUTCompare, and if supply voltage V DDBe lower than the voltage V at lead-out terminal 2 places OUT, comparator 6 control switchs 5 then are so that its contact 5a links to each other with 5c.When the contact of switch 5 5a linked to each other with 5c, because the current potential at conductive terminal t3 place is higher than the current potential at conductive terminal t4 place, the grid of MOS transistor Q2 and conductive terminal t3 were by short circuit.This makes MOS transistor Q2 end, and does not therefore have back flow current to flow to power supply terminal 1 from lead-out terminal 2.

In adjuster shown in Figure 1, directly detecting the state that wherein has back flow current probably by comparator 6 (is supply voltage V DDBe lower than the voltage V at lead-out terminal 2 places OUTState), and according to this testing result, MOS transistor Q2 ends.This makes can prevent back flow current safely.

In addition, the transistor of same conductivity type (P raceway groove) is used as MOS transistor Q1 and Q2, thereby the effect by the parasitic diode D2 that forms in MOS transistor Q2 has prevented the back flow current that is caused by the parasitic diode D1 that forms in MOS transistor Q1.By according to forming the MOS transistor Q2 that is used as power cut-out switch, can further reduce the on-state resistance of MOS transistor Q2 in normal running with the approximately uniform transistor size of the MOS transistor Q1 that is used as power transistor.

Supply voltage V is being provided by car battery DDSituation under owing to use the mode of car battery in the reality, so supply voltage V DDCan descend in moment, perhaps even shorted to earth.Even in this case,, the output capacitor of a high capacitance is linked to each other with lead-out terminal 2, so that stablize the voltage V at lead-out terminal 2 places for the fault of the load (as microcomputer) that prevents to link to each other with the lead-out terminal 2 of adjuster OUT

The supply voltage V that provides by car battery as mentioned above is provided when use DDAnd during the adjuster shown in Figure 1 of the load that links to each other with lead-out terminal 2 and high capacitance output capacitor, at supply voltage V DDSharply under the situation about descending, state (the supply voltage V that adjuster is in occur back flow current probably DDBe lower than the voltage V at lead-out terminal 2 places OUTState).Because adjuster shown in Figure 11 is configured, even so that under the state that occurs back flow current probably, also prevented back flow current safely, so this adjuster is fit to be used as the supply unit of the vehicle-mounted facility such as automobile stereo system and auto-navigation system.

As shown in Figure 2, when the contact of switch 5 5c does not link to each other with the node that MOS transistor Q1 links to each other with Q2, and the node that links to each other with MOS transistor Q1, resistor R 1, comparator 6 and lead-out terminal 2 also can be realized the identical advantage of adjuster as shown in Figure 1 when linking to each other.

Fig. 3 illustrates a kind of actual example of adjuster circuit structure shown in Figure 2.What should illustrate is, Fig. 3 plants those also detectable circuit elements in Fig. 1 and and no longer repeats their detailed description with identical reference numbers identify.

The grid of MOS transistor Q2 links to each other with the conductive terminal t8 of MOS transistor Q4, the back of the body grid of MOS transistor Q4 and conductive terminal t7 link to each other with conductive terminal t5 and the back of the body grid of MOS transistor Q3, and the conductive terminal t6 of MOS transistor Q3 links to each other with lead-out terminal 2 by resistor R 4.Here, should be noted that in MOS transistor Q3, along direction shown in the figure, promptly the direction from conductive terminal t6 to back of the body grid forms parasitic diode D3, and, in MOS transistor Q4, along direction shown in the figure, promptly the direction from conductive terminal t8 to back of the body grid forms parasitic diode D4.One end of resistor R 3 links to each other with input terminal 1, and the other end of resistor R 1 links to each other with the grid of MOS transistor Q3 and the grid of MOS transistor Q4.Input terminal 1 links to each other with the grid of MOS transistor Q2 by resistor 5 and Zener diode ZD1, and the grid of MOS transistor Q2 is by resistor R 6 ground connection.

Here, mention the grid of MOS transistor Q3 and the voltage between the conducting region terminal t6, in order that to supply voltage V DDVoltage V with lead-out terminal 2 places OUTCompare.This helps to realize wideer dynamic range.

In said structure, when normal running, MOS transistor Q3 remain off.So, parasitic diode D3 keeps conducting, therefore, unless the effect owing to the parasitic diode D4 in the MOS transistor Q4 of failing prevents the electric current by parasitic diode D3, the grid potential of MOS transistor Q2 can not drop to ground level, but keeps equaling voltage V OUTDeduct the V of MOS transistor Q3 FBecause MOS transistor Q4 is set is prevented from this point.

In normal running, MOS transistor Q3 and Q4 remain off, and, there is not extra electric current to flow through parasitic diode D3 and D4.Therefore, deduct the Zener voltage of Zener diode ZD1, determined the grid potential of MOS transistor Q2, and therefore this potential setting can be equaled earth potential by supply voltage.On the other hand, as supply voltage V DDBe lower than the voltage V at lead-out terminal 2 places OUTThe time, MOS transistor Q3 and Q4 keep conducting, and MOS transistor Q2 remain off.Therefore, there is not back flow current to flow to power supply terminal 1 from lead-out terminal 2.

Above-mentioned explanation only relates to wherein the voltage V that is used to detect lead-out terminal 2 places OUTVoltage detecting circuit be configured to the example of resistor voltage divider circuit.But, can also use the voltage detecting circuit that substitutes with any alternate manner structure.Above-mentioned explanation only relates to wherein the example with the contact 5b ground connection of switch 5.But, the contact 5b of switch 5 can also be linked to each other with current potential except that ground, as long as this current potential can make MOS transistor Q2 conducting.
